# 蛋蛋影院 / Dandan Cinema

> 本机私人片单、Android TV 播放器与可选 MCP/CLI Agent 接口，中英双语。A local personal watchlist and Android TV player with Chinese/English UI and optional local stdio MCP or JSON CLI access for the user's own assistant.

Public preview 0.1.0-preview.1. Windows installation path, Python 3.11+, optional Android TV sideload. The app stores a local library; an external AI host may transmit returned text under its own data policy. No bundled films, automatic source discovery, DRM bypass or universal video-site support. Public-APK physical-TV acceptance and individual agent-client acceptance remain pending.

MCP defaults to three query tools. Writes require DANDAN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1; deletion also needs a preview and actual user confirmation. The endpoint is local stdio, not a hosted URL. This index points to raw text for retrieval and does not grant permission to operate a user's library.

- [中文安装](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/docs/INSTALL.zh-CN.md): Windows setup, optional TV pairing and authorized local media preparation.
- [English installation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/docs/INSTALL.md): equivalent step-by-step English setup.
- [MCP and CLI integration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/docs/AGENTS.md): actual setup, permissions, Codex configuration and OpenClaw CLI/skill example.
- [Local API contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/docs/API.md): routes, concurrency, source and preparation semantics.
- [Validation limits](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/docs/VALIDATION.md): tests and builds versus pending physical-device/client acceptance.
- [Security boundaries](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/main/SECURITY.md): local trust, TV transport, data handling and reporting.
- [Published preview](https://github.com/Erica1018/dandan-cinema/releases/tag/v0.1.0-preview.1): source archives, signed APK and checksums.
